name: casualfunnel
description: CausalFunnel - full-stack user analytics: embeddable tracker, NestJS ingestion/aggregation API, React dashboard.

scripts.dev: npm run tracker:build && concurrently -k -n backend,dashboard -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @casualfunnel/backend" "npm run dev -w @casualfunnel/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @casualfunnel/tracker && node scripts/copy-tracker.mjs && npm run build -w @casualfunnel/backend && npm run build -w @casualfunnel/dashboard
scripts.test: npm run test -w @casualfunnel/backend && npm run test -w @casualfunnel/tracker
